description: A D_PDU to a peer of unknown edition carries EMPTY, not CAPABILITY, and the transmission is not padded.
note: The flow of dts-nonarq-send-single-segment: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). Each S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is to SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 (the 648000-unit default, so TTD = request time + 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091), and asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095). The CAS wraps the DATA S_PDU (priority, SAP 5 to SAP 5, TTD) in a DATA C_PDU (B-0297). Each D_PDU is type 7 NON-ARQ-DATA (C-0323, C-0575) with EOW 0, EMPTY (C-0398), address size 3 (the smallest that holds both addresses, C-0133), source 0.0.1.2, the whole C_PDU as its one segment (offset 0, C_PDU size = segment size, C-0343, C-0346), DELIVER IN ORDER clear (C-0333), C_PDU IDs allocated from 0 in placement order (C-0326, C-1040), and no pre-fill (D-0003). The air start of a D_PDU is the start of the block holding its first byte, preamble_ms + block x block_ms (C-1043); EOT = ceil((duration_ms - air start) / 500) (C-0104, C-0891, D-0005, D-0017), and the reception window is the same value because every copy of the C_PDU is in this transmission (C-0350, C-0352). The waveform is drc.default_speed, wn 2 long (C-0894). U_PDU "hello" priority 0 to 0.0.1.3. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 256 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so the 35-byte D_PDU needs one block, duration 5550 ms, EOT and reception window ceil(4950 / 500) = 10. Contention: LBT 30000 (DCD-determined idle at time 0, K-0070), seed 0 draws slot 15, 45000 ms (K-0080). On transmit_done the MAC returns to SENSE (K-0092, K-0093) and, with nothing queued, stays there (K-0064). Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050). 0.0.1.3 has never been negotiated with and has sent nothing, so it is of unknown edition: the type 7 carries EOW 0, EMPTY, because Ed4 EOWs are not used where the edition is unknown (C-0419, C-0055, C-1260), and the 221 spare bytes of the block are left to the modem's zero fill, no PADDING (C-1154).
